examples.en: They lived on a small island.
That island is uninhabited.
Stay in touch with me.
We have no contact with them.
He paid a fine for speeding.
He deserved a severe punishment.

tips: «Новчана казна» is a fine (a money penalty). The verb «казнити» means both to fine and to punish.

examples.en: You're absolutely right.
I know absolutely nothing about it.
What illness does he have?
That disease is contagious.
He hit the target on the first try.
He's an easy target now.
Don't touch that!
Who touched my phone?
He is prone to exaggeration.
She is not inclined to compromise.

note: склон + dat.: склон пићу (prone to drink)

examples.en: Somebody shot him last night.
If you move, I'll shoot you!
Make a shopping list.
Your name isn't on the list.
What's bothering you?
He struggled with that task for a long time.

examples.sr: Не [претва̀рај] се да ме не видиш.
examples.en: Don't pretend you don't see me.
This machine turns water into ice.
Say hi to Mom from me!

examples.sr: Ушао је и није нас ни [поздра̀вио].
examples.en: He came in and didn't even say hello to us.

tips: «Поздравите мога тату» means say hello to my dad. «Поздравити се» means to greet each other or to say goodbye.
«Поздравити некога» is to pass on greetings («Поздрави маму»), not only to say hello. Congratulating on a holiday is «честитати».

examples.en: He's not right in the head!
I just want a normal life.
I can't find my keys anywhere.
I'm not going anywhere tonight.

note: also with motion: не идем нигде - I'm not going anywhere

examples.en: I want to thank you for your help.
Thank Grandma for the present.

note: захвалити некоме на нечему - to thank someone for something
tips: Захвалити некоме на нечему: захвалила сам Ани на помоћи (dat. + на + loc.).
It needs «се» and the dative: захвалити се некоме - to thank someone. Захвалила сам му се.

examples.en: Are you having fun at the party?
They've been dating for a year.

note: забављати се са неким - to date someone
tips: забављати се also means to date (of a couple): «Лука се забавља са апотекарком». Забављати means to entertain: забављати госте.

examples.en: I love chocolate!
Children adore him.
This is my cousin Marko.
He's a distant relative of ours.

tips: «Рођак/рођака» can mean any relative, not only a first cousin. For male first and second cousins people often just say «брат»: «Он је мој брат».

examples.en: What brings you here?
How do you know my name?

meanings: to know how to, to be able to

examples.en: Can you swim?
I can't cook.

note: умети да + present: умем да возим (I can drive)
tips: Умети is to have a skill: «умем да кувам». Знати is to know facts, «могу» is possibility or permission: «могу да дођем сутра».

examples.en: In winter we go to the mountains.

examples.sr: Ова [планѝна] је висока преко две хиљаде метара.
examples.en: This mountain is over two thousand meters high.
Actually, you're wrong.
He's actually a good man.
The dog is gnawing a bone.
He broke a bone in his arm.
He was fired from his job.
The boss is going to fire me!

note: most often means to fire (from a job)

examples.en: Grandpa has high blood pressure.
I work under great pressure.
I have plenty of experience in that.
That was a nice experience.

tips: Often plural: «различита искуства», «радна искуства». «Знам из свог искуства» - I know from my own experience.
«Радно искуство» is work experience.

forms: извињавам се, извињавају се; pf. извинити се

examples.en: I apologize for being late.
You don't have to apologize.

tips: Извињавати се некоме због нечега: извинио се Ани због кашњења (dat. + због + gen.).

examples.en: Good luck on the exam!
They lived happily ever after.
Return to base at once!
All the data is in the database.
The whole team is here.
I'm going out with the gang tonight.
He was dead drunk.
Don't drive when you're drunk!
You saved my life.
We have to save her!
She got the lead role in the film.
Money plays no role here.

tips: главна улога - lead role, споредна улога - supporting role; играти улогу - to play a role.

examples.en: We signed the contract yesterday.
That wasn't in the contract.
It suddenly started to rain.
Don't eat it all at once!
Understood, Sergeant!
The sergeant gave an order.
Breathe deeply and calm down.
I can't breathe!
Your new phone is really cool.
Everything's cool, don't worry.

tips: Slang, does not decline: баш је кул, кул тип, скроз кул. The verb «искулирати» means to chill out, to not care.

examples.en: Your brother is really good-looking.
This is a good opportunity to talk.

tips: Of a woman, «згодна» means having a nice figure («витка» is slim); «Каква ти је линија!» - what a figure you have!
Of a person it means well-built, more often of men: «згодан момак». The opposite «незгодан» means awkward, hard to deal with.

examples.sr: Да ли је [и̏ко] видео моје наочаре?
examples.en: Has anyone seen my glasses?
I love you more than anyone.

note: in questions and comparisons; in a statement use неко

examples.en: The plane is flying over the city.
The lamp hangs above the table.
The witch turned him into a frog.
We converted the attic into a room.

note: претворити у + acc. - to turn into something

examples.en: I speak a little Serbian.
I'm a bit tired.
We met completely by chance.

examples.sr: Да ли [слу̏ча̄јно] знаш где је пошта?
examples.en: Do you happen to know where the post office is?
How much does this shirt cost?
It will cost you dearly.

meanings: to light, to set on fire

examples.en: Turn on the light, please.
The car won't start.

tips: Упалити/угасити - to turn a light or fire on/off: «упали светло», «угаси ватру». For devices «укључити» and «искључити» are more usual.

examples.en: He fell after the first blow.

examples.sr: То је био тежак [у̀дарац] за њега.
examples.en: That was a heavy blow for him.
Turn on the washing machine.
This machine runs day and night.

tips: Most often an appliance or a machine tool: веш-машина, машина за судове.

examples.en: Look at this old photo.
My grandmother is in the photo.
I've been waiting for you for a whole hour!
I spent my whole childhood in the countryside.
That is my duty.
The policeman was on duty.
It's very cold outside.
He gave me a cold look and left.
Your call surprised me.
Let's surprise Mom!

tips: To be surprised is «изненадити се»: «Он се изненадио». The state of being surprised is «бити изненађен»: «Она је била изненађена».
Изненадити некога + instr.: «мама нас је изненадила ненајављеним путовањем». The imperfective is изненађивати.

examples.en: That's an order!
I'm just following orders.
Corn grows in the field behind the house.
He's an expert in his field.

tips: In farming «поље» is the general word; professionally people distinguish ливада (meadow), пашњак (pasture), ораница (plowland), њива (field), виноград (vineyard), воћњак (orchard).

examples.en: There's no phone signal here.
Wait for my signal.
I'm madly in love with her.
We had a blast.
I respect your decision.
Everyone must follow the rules.
The mailman brings us packages.
He makes all the decisions in the house.

note: доносити одлуку - to make a decision

examples.en: His father is in the military service.
The church service starts at nine.
There's a secret passage behind the wardrobe.
They had a secret affair.
How much did you earn last month?
I want to earn enough for an apartment.

meanings: to joke around, to goof off (reflexive)

examples.en: Don't mess with me, I'm serious!
I'm just kidding, relax.

note: colloquial; зезнути also means to cheat, to let down
tips: «Зезати се» is slang for to hang out and goof off; «зезати некога» is to tease someone.
«Зезнут» means in an unpleasant situation, in a mess. Colloquial, not for formal speech.
To kid or prank someone (Зезаш ме! - You're kidding me!); to act up (Нешто ме зеза телефон - my phone is acting up). Зезати се: to joke or to relax in company: Добро смо се зезали.

meanings: to appeal to, to be liked
forms: допадам се, допадају се; pf. допасти се

examples.en: I like your dress.
Do you like Belgrade?

note: works like «to appeal to»: допада ми се - I like it
tips: A synonym of свиђати се, a bit more bookish: Допада ми се твој стан. The person who likes is in the dative (ми, ти), the thing liked is the subject.

examples.en: This passport is fake.
It was a false alarm.

examples.sr: Не брини, [иона̀ко̄] сам хтео да идем.
examples.en: Don't worry, I was going to leave anyway.
There's no point in waiting anyway.
There isn't enough room in the apartment.
I need a bit of space.
The wedding was a big event.
He told us about that incident.
Raise your hand if you know the answer.
I have to withdraw money from the bank.

tips: Подићи пошиљку - to pick up a parcel at the post office or a parcel locker; подићи новац - to withdraw money from an account.

examples.en: Have fun tonight!
The clown entertained the children.
Silence, please!
I love the quiet of the forest.
I have great respect for him.
Sincerely, Marko Petrović.

meanings: just so, for no particular reason

examples.sr: Урадио сам то [она̀ко̄] како си рекао.
examples.en: I did it the way you said.
I'm just asking, out of curiosity.

tips: As an answer to «како је било?» it means so-so, nothing special: «Онако, ништа посебно».

examples.en: I don't feel like doing it.
He did it against his will.
I accept your offer.

examples.sr: Добио сам [по̀нуду] за посао у Берлину.
examples.en: I got a job offer in Berlin.
They found his fingerprints on the gun.
A footprint was visible in the sand.

examples.sr: Могу ли да вас замолим за [пле̑с]?
examples.en: May I have this dance?
She goes to dance classes.
There he is, coming!

examples.sr: Где су ми кључеви? - [Е̏но] их на столу.
examples.en: Where are my keys? - There they are, on the table.

note: ево - here it is (near), ено - there it is (far)

examples.en: Turn off the TV, it's time for bed.
He was expelled from school.
Pass me the salt, please.
I have something else to add.
We sat in a circle around the fire.

examples.sr: Возимо се у [кру̑г] већ сат времена.
examples.en: We've been going around in circles for an hour.
The operation starts at midnight!
Coffee is on sale this week.

tips: Also a store promotion: «акција на дечије мајице» - a sale on kids' T-shirts. Not only «operation» or «action».
Among hikers it means an outing: «Идемо у акцију», «пријавити се за акцију». Тура is a route or tour, једнодневни излет a day trip.

examples.en: Do you want to dance with me?
I don't know how to dance.
A series of strange things happened.
We went down the stairs.
His father is a military doctor.
That is a military secret.
Dad, you're my hero!
He returned home a hero.
You won't believe what happened!
Nobody believed me.
Get out of the vehicle!
This vehicle has been stolen.

tips: Путничко возило - passenger car, теретно возило - freight vehicle. Одјава возила - deregistration of a vehicle, регистарске таблице - license plates.

examples.en: There is no doubt that he is guilty.
Suspicion fell on the neighbor.
Have you lost your mind?
He's smart, but lazy.

tips: From памет comes the adverb напамет: «знати напамет» - to know by heart. «Пасти на памет» - to come to mind.

examples.en: We have different tastes.
The brothers are completely different.
Could you repeat that, please?
This won't happen again.
We're watching the match tonight.
Who won the match?

tips: «Добити утакмицу» - to win a match, «изгубити утакмицу» - to lose it. «Прећи у други клуб» - to move to another club (of a player), «пребацити у други клуб» - to transfer someone to another club.

examples.en: I really appreciate your help.
Everyone respects him as a person.
She is different from other girls.
I thought it would be different.
In summer we swim in the river.
Belgrade lies on two rivers.
I've lost faith in people.
What religion is he?
You're absolutely right.
I got soaked to the skin.

tips: A colloquial intensifier, totally or absolutely, with verbs and adjectives: «скроз сам сигуран». The name of a bakery, «Скроз добра пекара», is a pun.

examples.en: Don't turn on the light, the kids are asleep.
The neighbor is burning leaves in the yard.

tips: In youth slang: «морам да палим» - I have to go; «палити» - to leave quickly.
Палити светло - to turn the light on, гасити светло - to turn it off: Упали / угаси светло. Also палити кола - to start the car.
Colloquial: «палим» - I'm off («Палимо одавде!» - Let's get out of here!); «то не пали» - that doesn't work; «палити се на некога» - to fall for someone. Basic meaning: to burn, to light.

examples.en: The fridge is empty again.
The streets were empty.
Do you smoke?

examples.sr: Престао сам да [пу̏шим] пре две године.
examples.en: I quit smoking two years ago.
The drive to the sea takes five hours.
Thanks for the ride!
He's my best friend.

examples.sr: Играо сам се са [друга́рима] из краја.
examples.en: I played with the kids from my neighborhood.
Our tomcat is too fat.
Put on a thick sweater, it's cold.
I just wanted to protect you.
This cream protects your skin from the sun.
Our cat sleeps on the bed.
Do you have a dog or a cat?

tips: Of a woman: good-looking, well-groomed, attractive («права мачка»). Not to be confused with «риба», which in slang is just a woman or a girl.
Мачка is a loanword from Hungarian; the male is мачак. «Окотити се» means to give birth, of cats and some other animals.

examples.en: Children are playing with a ball in the park.
Pass me the ball!
The police used force.
I can't force you.
Can I pay by card?
I lost my credit card.

tips: To pay by card: платити картицом (instr.); in cash - готовином. A common question: Може ли картицом?

meanings: to toss in, to throw in

examples.en: Insert a coin into the machine.
Toss the stuff in the trunk.

tips: Убацити реч - to slip in a word, убацити картицу - to insert a card, «убацити некога у фирму» - to get someone a job at a firm. «Убацивати се» - to butt in: «Немој да се убацујеш!»

examples.en: What time are you coming?
Autumn is my favorite time of year.
Why are you so nervous?
She was nervous before the exam.
I heard some strange sound.
Turn up the volume, I can't hear anything!
Listen to me carefully.
Drive carefully, the road is slippery.
The wound heals quickly.
First I need to clean the wound.
He lives in a big villa on a hill.
The fairy granted him three wishes.

tips: Also a fairy-like creature of South Slavic mythology, something between a fairy and a nymph, not only a villa.
In Serbian mythology, a beauty of the mountains, forests and waters. She can help and heal, but an angry вила is best left alone: she brings storms and illness.

examples.en: The water level in the river is rising.
Your Serbian is at a high level.
Mars is the red planet.
We must take care of our planet.
Your hands are dirty, wash them.
I put the dirty laundry in the machine.
Speak more quietly, the baby is sleeping.
She went quietly into the room.
Thank you for the invitation.
Thanks to you, everything is fine.

tips: By the school rule, «захваљујем» without «се» means yes, thank you, while «захваљујем се» means no, thank you (in reply to «Хоћете ли кафу?»). Not everyone keeps the distinction in real life.

examples.en: You're a real angel.
The baby sleeps like an angel.
His grandfather was killed in the war.
Two people died in the accident.
It doesn't matter to me, I don't care.

examples.sr: Био је уморан, али је [свејѐдно] дошао.
examples.en: He was tired, but he came anyway.

tips: Expresses indifference: «њему је свеједно». Vivid synonyms: «баш га брига», «боли га уво» (literally: his ear hurts).

examples.sr: Као дете сам желео да летим у [све̏мӣр].
examples.en: As a child I wanted to fly into space.
How big is the universe?

tips: Свемир is outer space: путовања у свемир - space travel. Свемирски брод - spaceship. Васиона - universe.

examples.en: Tell me all the details.
I don't remember every detail.

tips: «Детаљ» is masculine: мали детаљ.

examples.en: Is there a pharmacy nearby?
We live near the school.

note: у близини + gen. - near, close to

examples.en: This is private property.
That's my personal business.
He threw a stone into the water.
The house is built of stone.
Congratulations on the victory!
This is a big victory for us.
It's dangerous to swim here.
You drive too dangerously.
Since when do you smoke?
Since he moved away, I rarely see him.

tips: Откад means since. For an action that is still going on, use the present tense: «откад живим у Србији» - since I have been living in Serbia.

examples.en: This is my favorite song.
What's your favorite movie?
Help me move the wardrobe.
Move over a bit!
He represents our company.
This is a big problem.
He gave a lovely speech at the wedding.
The child has a speech problem.

tips: Speech as a public talk or a manner of speaking; also a dialect or local way of speaking.

examples.en: Who is responsible for this?
She is a very responsible person.
I share a room with my sister.
We don't share the same opinion.
I've been learning German for two years.
He drives a German car.
It's raining outside.
Take an umbrella, it's going to rain.

tips: A children's rhyme for brushing teeth: «Киша пада» (rain falls) - the upper teeth, brushing down; «трава расте» (grass grows) - the lower teeth, brushing up.

examples.en: New goods arrive tomorrow.
This store has quality goods.

examples.sr: Веровао сам ти, а ти си ме [ѝздао]!
examples.en: I trusted you, and you betrayed me!
He wants to rent the apartment out to students.

tips: Издајица - a traitor (f.); издати некога - to betray someone. But also издати књигу - to publish a book, издати стан - to rent out an apartment.

examples.en: I swear I'm innocent!
Innocent people suffered.
He opened his own shop downtown.
The plot of the film is boring.

tips: Besides a shop it means the plot of a film or book (радња филма/књиге) and an action (рефлексна, инстинктивна радња). «Радња ради до девет» - the shop is open until nine.

examples.en: On weekends I like to walk in nature.
It's in his nature.
He is a calm and quiet man.
I wish you a peaceful night.
What is your opinion?
I changed my mind.

note: по мом мишљењу - in my opinion
tips: The result of thinking: «моје мишљење је да ...» - my opinion is that.... The process of thinking itself is «размишљање».

examples.en: He claims he is innocent.
I'm not claiming that I'm right.
I have no money on me.
Be careful when driving.
Who is your leader?
They arrested the gang leader.

note: masculine, but declines like a feminine noun: наш вођа, вођу

examples.en: Comrades, let's begin the meeting.
He was my comrade in the army.
Why are you silent?
Be quiet and listen!

tips: «Ћути!» - Be quiet!, «Ћутим» - I'm silent. Do not confuse with «чути» (to hear) and «чувати» (to keep, to guard): three similar verbs with different meanings.

examples.en: This is too expensive for me.
I'm too tired to go out.
I have a theory about that.

examples.sr: У [тѐорији] то ради, у пракси не.
examples.en: It works in theory, but not in practice.
Did you lock the door?
Don't forget to lock the car!
He bought her a ring for the engagement.
He wears a wedding ring.
I live on the fifth floor.

examples.sr: Ово ми је [пе̑тӣ] пут у Београду.
examples.en: This is my fifth time in Belgrade.
Your behavior is unacceptable.
I'm sorry for my behavior.
I mostly work from home.
People here are mostly polite.
Who is the owner of this car?
He owns the restaurant.
Hundreds of people are waiting in line.
Lend me a hundred dinars.
He has his own company.
I saw it with my own eyes.
The actors come out on stage.
Don't make a scene in front of everyone!
I had a terrible day.
This is terrible news.

examples.sr: Ко ће га [заме́нити] док је на одмору?
examples.en: Who will replace him while he is on vacation?
I mistook you for your brother.
He was naked to the waist.
The child is running around naked on the beach.

note: m. го, f. гола; гол (m.) is a goal in football

examples.en: Where do you buy bread?
Don't buy anything else, we have everything!
We walked along the seashore.
We crossed to the other bank of the river.
He started his career as a waiter.
This scandal will ruin his career.
I have a personal problem.
I lost my ID card.
Call a taxi, it's late.
I came by taxi.
Don't film me, I'm not ready!
Where is that movie being shot?
This cake is really good!
Ask him nicely and he'll agree.
For God's sake, what happened to you?
Let me go, for God's sake!
Just behave normally.
Are you coming? - Of course!
I work at a small company.
He opened his own company.
The bird broke its wing.
He took me under his wing.
This island is a real paradise.
Good people go to heaven.
I filmed everything with my phone.
Can you take a picture of us?
Who won the race?
This is a race against time.
We drank water from the spring.
Who is your source of information?
Return the seat to an upright position.
He holds a high position in the company.

related.en: to put, to lay; to pass (an exam)

examples.en: This isn't funny!
He told a funny joke.
Turn left at the traffic light.
The post office is to the left of the bank.
Don't be angry with me.
You know that makes me angry.

note: љутити се на + acc. - to be angry at
tips: «Наљутити се» is to get angry or take offense (once), «љутити се» is to be angry: «Немој се љутити!» - Don't be angry, don't take offense.

examples.en: A police car is parked in front of the house.
They took him to the police station.
Someone kidnapped his daughter.
He snatched the bag out of my hands.
He bought a new car.
The car is parked in front of the building.
Pack the camping gear.
This equipment is very expensive.
What are you doing, man?
Come on, hurry up!

tips: Intensifies emotion: «Шта радиш, бре?» - What the heck are you doing?; «Дођи, бре!» - Come here, man!; «Где си, бре?» - anything from reproach to joy at meeting.
Placed at the end of an emotional remark, it intensifies any emotion - surprise, anger, joy: «Где си, бре!» (when meeting), «Носи се, бре!» (get lost).
Strengthens tone and emotion: «Хајде, бре, касниш!» - come on, you're late; «Браво, бре!» - well done, you. Together with «брате»: «Ма дај, бре, брате!». It cannot be translated literally.

examples.en: The director is waiting for you in his office.
He is the school principal.
I came, although I didn't have time.
Although he is sick, he goes to work.
He cheated me out of money.
Did she cheat on you?
I think much the same.
Something similar has happened to me before.
The evil witch put a spell on the princess.
She dressed up as a witch for the masquerade.
Don't move, police!
The dog is wagging its tail.
Don't open the window, it's cold.
The store opens at eight.
The cake is heart-shaped.
Water can be in a solid form.
Take the keys out of your bag.
The dentist pulled my tooth.
